Specification: This specification models Safra's distributed termination-detection algorithm on a ring, following EWD 998. Nodes maintain activity status, colors, counters for sent-minus-received messages, pending in-flight messages, and a circulating token carrying position, accumulated quantity, and color; the spec also includes auxiliary loop and formula-tracking variables used to encode and check temporal properties. It verifies a safety-style termination-detection condition, an invariant inspired by Safra's inductive argument, and a liveness-style temporal property that termination is eventually detected under weak fairness of the system token actions, with an explicit state constraint used to bound TLC exploration.
IfThenElse: IF token.pos = N-1 THEN token.q = 0 ELSE token.q = FoldFunctionOnSet(Plus, 0, counter, {x \in Node: (token.pos+1) <= x})
FunctionOverride:
[token EXCEPT !.pos = @ - 1,
                            !.q = @ + counter[i],
                            !.color = IF color[i] = "black" THEN "black" ELSE @]
